subject: Commit Sentinel: Nimbus pipeline risk notice and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:13:00 -0000
Subject: Commit Sentinel: initial pipeline snapshot (Nimbus focus)

Team — attaching a quick snapshot ahead of EOD commit reviews. I pulled deals we flagged in last week's forecast sweep and highlighted ones that shifted stage in the last 14 days. Please do two things by EOD today: 

1) Mark your owned deals red/yellow/green in the attached CSV (pipeline_snapshot_may25.csv)
2) Reply with the single-line save plan for any RED deals (who owns next step and ETA)

Quick context: Nimbus (D-7842-NIM) moved from Proposal to Legal last week; procurement is asking for final PO timing and we need an updated commit. Marcus — see the rows flagged for legal risk. Aditya — any gating from architecture/support?

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_may25.csv (CSV, 48 KB)

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Commit Sentinel: initial pipeline snapshot (Nimbus focus)

Thanks Marissa — I updated the CSV with owner-state tags and added short notes in the comments column. Summary for quick scan: 

- RED: Nimbus (D-7842-NIM) — Legal timing unknown; procurement waiting on final contract language. Save plan: Marcus to own legal loop and escalate to contracts; expected 48-72h to get to PO if no new redlines.
- YELLOW: Atlas Health (D-7771) — pricing reconfirm required; Marissa to confirm list price vs committed discount by EOD.
- GREEN: Zephyr Labs (D-7688) — contract signed, awaiting invoicing.

Marcus — please confirm you can drive the legal review and give an earliest achievable PO date. Aditya — please call out any technical blockers that would materially change commit status for Nimbus. I will assemble a one-slide save plan for finance.

Also looping in external procurement contact once we have a committed date — let's avoid over-communicating until we have a clear next-step ETA.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 12:37:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Commit Sentinel: initial pipeline snapshot (Nimbus focus)

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 10:02 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus — please confirm you can drive the legal review and give an earliest achievable PO date.

I can take point on contracts for Nimbus. Current status from legal intake: counterparty returned 3 small redlines (data residency clause, audit window, and indemnity cap). I have sent the proposed concessions to our contracts team and asked for priority review.

Save-plan (short):
- Marcus to coordinate internal concessions and provide a tracked-change contract by Wed 26 May 18:00 UTC.
- Marissa to confirm commercial tolerance (discount/term) if legal asks for small pricing concession.
- Grace to update finance slide and mark D-7842 as YELLOW->RED guardrail until contract accepted.

I estimate 48-72 hours if legal approves the concessions; if exec approval is needed it could slip to 5 business days. I will update with timestamps and attach the draft when available.

Attachment: Nimbus_PO_terms_v2.pdf (stub for review)

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Contracts, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@nimbushealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Commit Sentinel: initial pipeline snapshot (Nimbus focus)

Thanks for the update. From procurement: can you confirm expected PO submission window? Our budget owner needs the date range to lock next quarter disbursements. If you can provide a target PO date and an updated draft contract, we can expedite on our side.

Also — if there are any required security attestations we should include on the PO, call that out now.

Best,
Elaine Kim
Sr. Procurement Manager, Nimbus Health
elaine.kim@nimbushealth.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@nimbushealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Commit Sentinel: initial pipeline snapshot (Nimbus focus)

Elaine — thanks for the quick note. Working plan below (finals by close of day tomorrow):

- Expected PO window: Target submission 2027-05-28 to 2027-05-30, pending legal sign-off. If contracts require exec review, we'll update and give a best-case/likely-case range.
- Draft contract: Marcus will share tracked changes to the PO by Wed 26 May 18:00 UTC (attached when ready).
- Security items: none new beyond our standard SOC 2 + data processing addendum; Marcus will flag if audit evidence is required before PO.

Action items for Redwood team: 
- Marcus: confirm tracked-change contract availability and escalate if exec approval required.
- Marissa: confirm any discount levers (commented in CSV).
- Aditya: confirm there are no new SRE/arch blockers for GA deployment (if you hit anything that would change timing say so).
- Grace: I will update finance slide and move D-7842 to RED->ON-WATCH in the commit sheet until PO is in-hand.

Grace — I'll add the HubSpot link to the one-slide summary and drop a short note in the CRM when the PO is attached. Elaine — cc-ing the procurement queue here; we'll follow up with the draft as soon as contracts finish the review.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
